remarks: Beautiful loft-style 2 BR, 2 full BTH condo at Eastside Commons. Totaling 1080 sq/ft, open concept combination layout with wide living space, high ceilings, large windows, bountiful natural light and fully equipped kitchen with center island and in-unit laundry. Personal balcony access from both living room and main bedroom. Ensuite main bedroom includes deep walk-in closet, large bath and glass sliders to balcony. Second bedroom includes deep walk-in closet and adjacent bathroom access. Beautiful resident's courtyard encircled by a brick walking path, trees, lush greenery and flowering plants. Outdoor patio seating and grill stations. Amenities include fitness room, beautiful club room and concierge. One reserved garage space. Eastside Commons is anchored by ever popular Kumo Restaurant and their newly opened grocery market. Great walkability to the city's thrilling nightlife, Stamford Town Center and lively downtown entertainment and restaurant scene. Accessible to all major transportation arteries, Metro North/Amtrak, public transportation, parks, beaches.
